specification.title: Transform menu action availability
specification.goal: Disable a Matrix Transform action unless its owned Rhino/OCCT/Matrix command is available
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Matrix Transform menu binds to Rhino/OCCT transforms

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Transform menu action availability” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Transform menu action availability”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Đọc source module owner trước khi sửa. Dữ liệu hiển thị/chọn không được thay đổi BRep khi chỉ có ý định đo hoặc kiểm tra.
Undo/Redo và save/reopen phải bảo toàn document state, errors phải hữu hình và có test cụ thể.

input.purpose: Disable a Matrix Transform action unless its owned Rhino/OCCT/Matrix command is available

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: Disable a Matrix Transform action unless its owned Rhino/OCCT/Matrix command is available
positive.expected: Affine transform maintains exact BRep where supported, valid transformed axes/units and stable object ID or explicit copy policy, undo/redo restores geometry.

negative.setup: Zero determinant or NaN matrix, non-invertible frame or cancel before commit.
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test
